character.name: Attacking
character.prompt: Edit the reference Demon King sprite. Change only its posture from quadrupedal to bipedal, standing on two powerful hind legs.  Preserve the exact character design: all three heads, facial features, expressions, horns, crown, colors, textures, body mass, bone plates, wings, tail and glowing details. Keep the central demonic head dominant and the secondary lion and goat heads unchanged.  Raise the torso into a slightly forward-leaning stance. Adapt the existing hind legs to support its weight, with both clawed feet firmly planted apart. Lift the existing forelegs off the ground so they hang beside the torso as massive clawed forelimbs, preserving their anatomy and proportions.  Maintain its monstrous, nonhuman appearance and imposing silhouette. Same south-facing view, pixel art style, pixel density, outlines, shading and transparent background. Entire body visible.  Do not redesign, add or remove features. No human anatomy, human posture, new equipment or changes to the heads.
